name: test-support-helper-use
description: A test whose references reach only test-support code and test-file code is not a test of dead code, because test-support code is test code: it is live while test code references it, and it is no target declaration a production sweep judges. So the test and the test-file helper beside it are reported under no code, the default minimum confidence withholds what is reported about the test-support function both call and the interface test-support code takes as a parameter type, and a production function nothing references is reported.
